title: Pre-Extraction and Matrix Application via a HTX M5 Sprayer for Intact Proteoform MALDI Imaging
author: Kevin J Zemaitis

steps.title: Initialize HTX M5 Sprayer
steps.instruction: Prepare the HTX M5 sprayer and pump system for operation.

substeps.instruction: Regulate house nitrogen gas flow to 10 PSI.
Turn on the pump power supply and initialize the HTX M5 sprayer via the controlling laptop application.
Set the sample valve to 'load' and purge the pump line, allowing it to spray through the nozzle.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Acidification Solution
steps.instruction: Purge the sample loop with the acidification solution.

substeps.instruction: Purge the sample loop with 5% acetic acid (AA) in 50% ethanol.
Run the solution through the nozzle for several minutes at the set flow rate.
Replenish the loop if the remaining volume is less than the volume to be sprayed.

steps.title: Secure Sample Slide
steps.instruction: Position and secure the slide on the sprayer bed.

substeps.instruction: Secure the slide with tape on the top and bottom edges for use with Spectroglyph sources, or on the sides for use with Bruker sources.

steps.title: Perform Tissue Acidification
steps.instruction: Apply the acidification method using the HTX M5 sprayer.

substeps.instruction: Load the tissue acidification method with the following parameters: 1250 mm/min nozzle velocity, 0.150 mL/min flow rate, 30 °C nozzle temperature, 3 mm track spacing, 'CC' pattern, 40 mm nozzle height, and 5 seconds drying time.
Set the slide position and start the method in the software.
Monitor nitrogen pressure for fluctuations.
Spray solution for several minutes to verify pump pressure and spray stability.
Start the method and monitor the sprayer to ensure viable acidification.
Weigh DHA into a scintillation vial (minimum 10 mL capacity) to a target concentration of 15 mg/mL and a total volume between 7-10 mL.
Add the calculated volume of 90% acetonitrile to the vial and vortex for several minutes.
Place the vial in an ultrasonic sonicator for 15 minutes.
Split the volume evenly into 2 mL Eppendorf tubes and centrifuge for several minutes.
Decant the resulting clear solution (after black precipitant forms) into a clean scintillation vial.

steps.title: Apply DHA Matrix
steps.instruction: Deposit the DHA matrix onto the acidified tissue.

substeps.instruction: Switch the valve from 'spray' to 'load' and purge the line and valve with the matrix solvent system.
Load the matrix into the loop with the injection valve on 'load', turn on the pump, and set the valve to 'spray'.
Check nitrogen pressure and spray for several minutes to verify pump pressure and spray stability.

Load the DHA deposition method with the following parameters: 1300 mm/min nozzle velocity, 0.150 mL/min flow rate, 30 °C nozzle temperature, 2 mm track spacing, 'CC' pattern, 40 mm nozzle height, 0 seconds drying time, and 4 passes for 277 μg/cm² coverage.
Start the method using the same application region as the acidification step and monitor the process.

steps.title: Optional Recrystallization
steps.instruction: Perform optional matrix recrystallization using a specialized apparatus.

substeps.instruction: Mount the sample onto an aluminum plate attached to the top of a petri dish with double-sided copper tape.
Place a Kimwipe in the bottom of the petri dish and saturate it with 1 mL of the solution immediately prior to use.
Place the mounted sample in the incubation chamber at 38.5 °C for 2 minutes.
Pipette 1 mL of 5% acetic acid in nanopure water into the bottom layer just before the timer expires and incubate for 3 minutes and 30 seconds.
Remove the bottom plate and place the sample back in the incubation chamber to dry.
Remove the dried sample from the incubator and the top plate.

steps.title: Tissue Quality Control
steps.instruction: Evaluate tissue integrity via visual inspection or bright-field (BF) microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Inspect for cracks, folds, detachment, and tears.
Ensure that these defects cover less than 10% of the section surface; otherwise, abort the run.

steps.title: System Shutdown
steps.instruction: Clean and power down the HTX M5 sprayer.

substeps.instruction: Switch the valve to 'spray', change pump flow rate to 0.3 mL/min, and purge for approximately 10 minutes.
Flush the sample loop in the same manner as previous steps.
Turn off the pump and sprayer power and stop the nitrogen flow.
